# 1. Environnement

```{r}
library(here)
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyverse)
library(stringr)
library(ggplot2)
library(gridExtra) # Afficher plusieurs ggplots en meme temps
```

# 2. working directory

```{r}
  # Working diretory
setwd(here::here("Data", "Data entomo"))
here()
```

# 3. 

```{r}
  # IMPORT Jeu de données coléoptères
Coleo <- read.table("jeu_donnees_coleo.txt", sep = "\t", dec = ".", quote = "\"", stringsAsFactors = F, header = T) %>%
  select(6 : 7, 10 : 20)

  # Calcul de l'abondance par piège
abondance <- Coleo %>%
  group_by(Numero_de_piege) %>%
  summarise(Abondance = sum(Abondance))
  # Graphique de visualisation 
ab <- ggplot(abondance, aes(x = Numero_de_piege, y = Abondance)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = c("darkgreen", "#458B00", "#556B2F", "#9ACD32")) +
  geom_text(aes(label = Abondance), vjust = -0.5, size = 3) +
  labs(title = "Abondance de coléoptères saproxyliques le long des arbres Thèses",
       x = "Pièges entomologiques",
       y = "Abondance (n)") +
  ylim(0, 10000) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 9, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0))

#

Coleobis <- Coleo %>%
  select(8, 9, 11, 13) %>%
  mutate(code_sp = ifelse((is.na(GEN) | GEN == "") & (is.na(SP) | SP == ""), "INC",
         paste(GEN, SP, sep = "_"))) %>%
  filter(!is.na(code_sp)) # Vérif des NAs

Coleobis<- Coleobis %>%
  setNames(c("GEN", "SP", "AB", "Num_piege", "code_sp")) %>%
  mutate(AB = as.numeric(AB)) %>%
  select(3 : 5) 

Coleo1 <- Coleobis %>%
  filter(Num_piege == 1) %>%
  group_by(code_sp) %>%
  summarise(AB = sum(AB))
ggplot(Coleo1, aes(x = code_sp, y = AB)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  geom_text(aes(label = AB), vjust = -0.5, size = 3) +
  labs(title = "Abondance des espèces capturées dans les pièges 1 des arbres Thèses",
       x = "Pièges entomologiques",
       y = "Abondance (n)") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 9, face = "bold"),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0))

Coleo2 <- Coleobis %>%
  filter(Num_piege == 2) %>%
  group_by(code_sp) %>%
  summarise(AB = sum(AB))
ggplot(Coleo2, aes(x = code_sp, y = AB)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  geom_text(aes(label = AB), vjust = -0.5, size = 3) +
  labs(title = "Abondance des espèces capturées dans les pièges 1 des arbres Thèses",
       x = "Pièges entomologiques",
       y = "Abondance (n)") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 9, face = "bold"),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0))
```

# 4. Analyses

```{r}

# l’ICA est-elle un milieu singulier en termes de diversité, d’abondance et de composition des assemblages de coléoptères saproxyliques ?

BMP_Strates <- read.csv("//no-datafile.inra.local/Biodiversite/projets/Bois_mort/Canopee/These_Balvay/Stagiaires/Adrien Debout - 03-02 au 01-08-2025/Data/Metriques_BMP_Strates_AD.csv", sep=";", header=TRUE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

BMP_Arbres <- read.csv("//no-datafile.inra.local/Biodiversite/projets/Bois_mort/Canopee/These_Balvay/Stagiaires/Adrien Debout - 03-02 au 01-08-2025/Data/Metriques_BMPtot_Arbres_AD.csv", sep=";", header=TRUE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

BMP_Placettes <- read.csv("//no-datafile.inra.local/Biodiversite/projets/Bois_mort/Canopee/These_Balvay/Stagiaires/Adrien Debout - 03-02 au 01-08-2025/Data/Metriques_BMPtot_Placette_AD.csv", sep=";", header=TRUE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

entomo <- read.table(here::here("Data", "Data placettes", "DATA_placette_CANOPIX", "metriques_CB", "metric_entomo2024.txt"), sep = "\t", dec = ".", quote = "\"", stringsAsFactors = F, header = T)

library(fitdistrplus)
descdist(entomo$ab.colsx,discrete=TRUE,boot=1001)
plot(fitdist(entomo$ab.colsx,"norm"))

fitnb<-fitdist(entomo$ab.colsx,"nbinom")
plot(fitdist(entomo$ab.colsx,"nbinom"))

fitp<-fitdist(entomo$ab.colsx,"pois")
plot(fitp)

fitn<-fitdist(entomo$ab.colsx,"norm")
plot(fitn) # oui

fitlnorm<-fitdist(entomo$ab.colsx,"lnorm")
plot(fitlnorm) # oui

fitexp<-fitdist(entomo$ab.colsx,"exp")
plot(fitexp)

fitgeom<-fitdist(entomo$ab.colsx,"geom")
plot(fitgeom)

fitbeta<-fitdist(entomo$ab.colsx,"beta") # Pas possible, pas 0/1


fitunif<-fitdist(entomo$ab.colsx,"unif")
plot(fitunif)

fitg<-fitdist(entomo$ab.colsx,"gamma",method="mme")
plot(fitg) # oui

BMP_Strates <- BMP_Strates %>%
  mutate(Vol_BMP_AC.m3 = 0, .before = "Vol_BMP_UC.m3") %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = 2 : 5, names_to = , values_to = )

model <- glmmTMB(rs.scol.non.ambrosia ~ entomo$ab.colsx+(1|cluster)+(1|idtrapyear)+exp(pos+0|ID),family="nbinom1",data=Rscolytexoticfcircul,na.action=na.fail)

#diagnostic glmm : ajustement, surdispersion, outliers
library(DHARMa)
sim<-simulateResiduals(model3)
testUniformity(sim)#le qqplot est issu de cette commande 
#KS Test p-value # Dispersion test  # Outliers 
testOutliers(sim)

```
